❯ Führe genau den Shell-Befehl echo herdr-app-dialog-test > probe.txt aus. Sonst nichts.

  Did not run 1 call
  ⎿  $ echo herdr-app-dialog-test > probe.txt
  ⎿  Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?
